description: Defines classes and types for managing datagram buffers, including a pool allocator and buffer handling for network socket operations in the Chromium project.

classes.name: DatagramBuffer
classes.description: Represents a network datagram buffer with methods for data access and management, intended to be created via DatagramBufferPool.

classes.name: DatagramBufferPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of datagram buffers, providing methods to enqueue and dequeue buffers for efficient reuse.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a copy of a buffer to the pool, associating it with a DatagramBuffers list.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Returns all buffers from a list back to the pool for reuse.

methods.name: max_buffer_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer size allowed in the pool.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer's data.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the buffer.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the buffer's data from a provided character array.
